picks.question: Will the unemployment rate (U-3) be above 4.1% in October?
picks.why: Unemployment above 4.1% would signal a cooling labor market, shaping Federal Reserve rate decisions and household income prospects heading into 2027.

picks.question: Will inflation reach more than 4.5% in 2026?
picks.why: Inflation above 4.5% would erode real wages, complicate Fed policy, and raise borrowing costs across the economy.

picks.question: Billionaire one-time wealth tax passes in California election 2026?
picks.why: A one-time billionaire wealth tax in California would test whether such taxes raise revenue or prompt wealthy residents to leave.

picks.question: Strait of Hormuz traffic returns to normal by December 31?
picks.why: Normal Strait of Hormuz traffic matters for global oil prices, shipping costs, and inflation pressures worldwide.

picks.question: Will Google have the best AI model at the end of December 2026?
picks.why: Which firm leads frontier AI shapes where investment, talent, and productivity gains concentrate in the technology sector.

picks.question: Will OpenAI announce another Millennium Prize solution by December 31, 2027?
picks.why: An AI-solved Millennium Prize problem would be a striking test of whether machines can produce genuinely new scientific discoveries.
